candidate.Reason: When Principal Type is set to Attribute [Name], the brokerUserId is constructed using config.getAlias() + "." + request.getNameID().getValue(), but this may not match the actual brokerUserId format used during login when principal type is attribute-based, causing session lookup to fail and sessions to remain active.

The brokerSessionId construction uses brokerUserId + "." + sessionIndex, but when Principal Type is Attribute [Name], the brokerUserId format may not match what was stored during login, causing getUserSessionByBrokerSessionId() to return null and sessions to remain logged in.

During login, the brokerUserId is constructed as config.getAlias() + "." + principal, where principal comes from the attribute value when Principal Type is Attribute [Name]. This format must be consistent with logout request processing.
The brokerSessionId is constructed as brokerUserId + "." + sessionIndex during login. This format must match exactly what is constructed during logout processing.
